name: Moog Muse
description: Moog Muse bitimbral analog polysynth: the MIDI CC appendix of its manual.

sources.title: Muse Manual 1.4.0
sources.notes: MIDI CC table (pages 120, 121, 122) read by tools/profiles/moog/read-moog-pdf.mjs from Muse_Manual-1.4.0.pdf (sha256 f8f67529295b1523d7d918f4025cbcf6fbb18bc798841d35da2411d8b0ba629e), https://cdn.inmusicbrands.com/Moog/Muse/Muse_Manual-1.4.0.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/moog/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/moog/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the manual prints no Device Inquiry reply.
The appendix does not say which timbre a controller edits; the profile sends on one channel, the channel variable.
A number, not a choice, where its bands are printed out of order (0-24, 25-49, 50-74, 5-99, 100-127): Modulation Oscillator Waveform (CC 28).

coverage.inboundControllers: the panel sends these same messages when its MIDI settings allow
